fit.summary: Supervises the same three functions, owns accuracy and scheduling, and has the WMS and forklift background the posting asks for.

bullets.text: Lead 14 associates across two shifts in receiving, picking, and shipping

cover_letter.hook: Prairie Freight is hiring a second-shift supervisor to own accuracy and on-time dispatch, which is the job I do now at Northwind Distribution.
cover_letter.body:
At Northwind Distribution I lead 14 associates across receiving, picking, and shipping. I brought our pick accuracy from 97.2% to 99.6% by making every pick scan-to-confirm, and I cut weekly overtime 25% by building the schedule around inbound truck times.

Safety is part of the routine for me. My team has gone 2 years without a recordable injury since we started weekly safety huddles. I also built a shift scheduling template that 40 small businesses use (example.com/shift-scheduler).
cover_letter.close: I would like to talk about how your Springfield second shift runs today and where it needs to go.

gaps: SAP is listed as a plus; John has not used it.
